name_zh: 成吉思汗/忽必烈/拖雷：蒙古游牧共识与大草原契约
name_en: Genghis Khan/Kublai/Tolui: Mongol Nomadic Consensus & Great Steppe Contract
description_zh: 成吉思汗 (1162-1227) 以库里台大会制、安达结义、大蒙古国大律札撒 (Yassa) 统一蒙古诸部，建立史上最大陆地帝国；忽必烈 (1215-1294) 完成南征、建元大都，推行行省制治理华夏；拖雷 (1193-1232) 作为监国、东征先锋，传承草原契约精神。三代君主跨越征服/治理/传承三阶段，共同体现 M159 蒙古游牧共识——流动性部落通过神圣契约 (Yassa) 与个人结义 (安达) 形成超稳定政治共同体，再以驿站制 (速把台) 实现跨欧亚大陆的资源调动与信息同步。
description_en: Genghis Khan (1162-1227) unified Mongol tribes via Kurultai assembly, Anda oath, and Great Yassa law, building history's largest land empire; Kublai (1215-1294) completed southern conquest, established Dadu, implemented provincial governance over China; Tolui (1193-1232) as regent and eastern campaign vanguard transmitted steppe contract spirit. Three generations across conquest/governance/transmission phases jointly exemplify M159 Mongol Nomadic Consensus—fluid tribes form ultra-stable political community through sacred contract (Yassa) and personal oath (Anda), then via Yam relay system achieve cross-Eurasian resource mobilization and information synchronization.
reason_zh: 蒙古帝国非靠强力维持，而是以"契约+结义+驿站"三位一体机制，将游牧流动性转化为政治稳定性。M159 独特区隔于 M146 乌班图(定居农耕)、M152 安第斯互惠(定居农耕)，核心在于"流动性+契约性"双重锚定。
reason_en: Mongol Empire sustained not by force but by trinity of "contract+oath+relay", converting nomadic fluidity into political stability. M159 uniquely distinct from M146 Ubuntu (settled agrarian) and M152 Andean Reciprocity (settled agrarian), core distinction: "fluidity+contractuality" dual anchoring.
steps_zh: 库里台合法性确立：全体贵族大会选举大汗，程序正义先于血统
安达结义网络构建：跨部落/跨族群个人誓盟，建立超氏族信任图谱
大律札撒立法固化：成文法典规定军制/刑法/商税/宗教宽容，契约成文化
驿站制资源调动：速把台网络覆盖欧亚，实现军令/情报/商贸跨大陆同步
代际传承与分封：忽必烈行省制、四大汗国分治，契约框架下的多中心治理
steps_en: Kurultai legitimacy establishment: noble assembly elects Great Khan, procedural justice over bloodline
Anda oath network building: cross-tribal/ethnic personal oaths, constructing trans-clan trust graph
Great Yassa legislative codification: written code covering military/criminal/commerce/religious tolerance, contract textualized
Yam relay resource mobilization: speed-putai network spanning Eurasia, achieving cross-continental sync of orders/intel/trade
Intergenerational transmission & appanage: Kublai provincial system, four khanates division, multi-centric governance within contract framework
expected_zh: 游牧文明以"流动性+契约性"机制实现超大规模政治整合，提供去中心化治理、跨文化资源调动的历史范式。
expected_en: Nomadic civilization achieves ultra-large political integration via "fluidity+contractuality" mechanism, providing historical paradigm for decentralized governance & cross-cultural resource mobilization.
case_zh: 1206年库里台选举成吉思汗→1219-1225西征花剌子模→1260忽必烈登基→1271建元大都→1294四大汗国名分确立，契约框架下162年帝国延续。
case_en: 1206 Kurultai elects Genghis -> 1219-25 western campaign Khwarezm -> 1260 Kublai enthroned -> 1271 Yuan Dadu established -> 1294 four khanates legitimized, 162-year imperial continuity within contract framework.
intellectual_tradition: Mongol Nomadic Governance / Yassa Legal Tradition
cross_cultural_impact: Yam relay inspired postal systems; Yassa influenced Islamic/Christian steppe law; Pax Mongolica enabled East-West exchange
resource_curse_mitigation: Pastoral wealth distribution via anda network; Yassa regulated herd taxation
